about.title: About
about.intro: My Top Words helps you learn vocabulary: each word comes in a sentence with a translation, then you practice in the trainer.
about.step1Text: On the home page you will find public sets. After signing up you can create your own or save someone else's.
about.step2Text: In a set every word has an example sentence and a translation. You can also listen to the pronunciation.
about.step3Text: In the trainer, translate the sentence, check your answer, and mark words as learned so the queue focuses on what you still need.
about.feedbackTextFab: Use the feedback button on any page to report a problem or suggest an improvement.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: A short note about the account, data, and materials.
terms.dataText: Username, password hash, your sets and learning progress; feedback messages if you send them. This data is not sold or used for advertising.
terms.accountText: Keep your password private. Actions under your login are considered yours.
terms.materialsText: Translations are for learning and may be imperfect. Public sets are created by their authors.
terms.contactText: Questions or issues can be sent via the feedback button on any page.
